snippet.title: Magical Drop 4/F (1999, PlayStation) - 19 of 30: Temperance / XIV. テンペランス [1080p60]
snippet.description:
Item power ([My] Favourite Pillow/お気にのマクラ) - (1) Makes opponent's Clown fall asleep for 3 seconds. (2) Increases number of Bubbles and Ice blocks to appear on opponent's playfield.
